name: Mitsubachi Gakuen
source:
Main character is a newly appointed teacher at the only idol training girls' school in Japan - Mitsubachi high school. For a year he looks after twenty students and solves a number of difficult cases targeting the girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是日本唯一一所偶像培训女子学校——蜜蜂高中的新任教师。他要照顾20名学生，并在一年里解决多起针对女孩们的棘手事件。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
